title: The CFO's Guide to Phased Odoo Rollouts: Protecting the Balance Sheet
content:
For a Chief Financial Officer or Finance Director, an ERP cutover is not an IT project—it is an existential risk to balance sheet integrity.

If the system stumbles:
- Invoices don't clear, freezing receivables collections.
- Inventory valuations fail to reconcile with supplier payables, exposing the company to tax audit re-assessments.
- Bank reconciliations fall weeks behind.

Here is how Scando's phased methodology safeguards financial governance throughout an Odoo rollout:

1. Parallel General Ledger Verification: Historical charts of accounts run side-by-side with Odoo's automated journal entries until the trial balance matches to the single cent for two consecutive fiscal closures.
2. Automated 3-Way Matching: Invoices cannot post to accounts payable without automated validation against goods receipt notes (GRN) and approved purchase orders.
3. Real-Time ETA Tax Compliance: Every sales invoice automatically receives tax authority validation (UUID and QR code) synchronously with warehouse delivery.
4. Real-Time Cash Flow Runway: Executive liquidity dashboards updating every 60 seconds across all bank accounts, open receivables, and mature payables.

Protect your company's financial heartbeat while scaling your operational technology.
